pulls.title: Read API v1: query results endpoint with cursor pagination
pulls.author: ada-moreno
pulls.body: Implements GET /v1/queries/:id/results per docs/read-api.md. Cursor pagination, per-key rate limit middleware, workspace-scoped API keys. TODO: usage metering.

pulls.title: Panel grid refactor: virtualized rendering
pulls.author: margaret-liu
pulls.body: Virtualizes the dashboard panel grid. NOTE: suspected cause of the p95 load regression (LUM-377) — the eager layout pass runs twice.

pulls.title: Spike: scheduled export worker on alerting cron
pulls.author: linus-park
pulls.body: Proves the export scheduler can ride the alerting cron infra. Missing: S3 multipart for >5GB dashboards, retry policy, Parquet writer.

# Read API v1

GET /v1/queries/:id/results
- Auth: workspace-scoped API key (header X-Lumen-Key)
- Pagination: cursor (opaque), max page 1000 rows
- Rate limit: 100 req/min/key, 429 with Retry-After
- Versioning: /v1 frozen after GA; breaking changes go to /v2

Open questions: usage metering for billing; column-level ACLs.
